notes: Random timer records (sometimes locked) with 0..3 random sequence records (mostly playing) and a random busy flag. Each sequence has a random event stream of delays, note-ons with varlen durations, other channel events, sysex, tempo, time-signature, other and end-of-track meta events; random note slots (sometimes all taken), loop counts, delays, beat state and volume/tempo ramps; beat and end callbacks are present or null. 0x1123a4, 0x103148, 0x111ed4, 0x112bd8, 0x111df0 and both callbacks log their stack arguments and clobber EAX/ECX/EDX; 0x103778 also writes its two output pointers. 0x111f20 and 0x111d98 run the original code. System common/realtime status bytes (0xf1..0xfe except 0xff) are left out: their data length is 0, so the original never advances past them.
